labels:
A WILD collects the collectible symbol only to its LEFT on
the SAME ROW. Coins to its right or in another row do not
pay. Each coin is counted once even with multiple
collectors.

Each collectible pays 0.15 × bet × cabinet factor.
Overlapping collectors never pay a coin twice. Add all
values before rounding.

Win tiers: BIG 10× · MEGA 50× · EPIC 100× stake. Total return, not extra
prizes.

Round cap 500,000 · All awards rounded
Virtual coins · No cash-out

substitutes for ordinary symbols.

prizes.
